name: Manuela Mischke-Reeds
reason: Her work is mainly clinical somatic trauma therapy and training for psychotherapists (ISITTA, Somatic Trauma Therapy Training, a Costa Rica retreat sold for treating PTSD, trauma and anxiety, psychedelic-assisted therapy), so almost nothing passes the health-claim rule: two of her books are trauma-titled, the Hakomi Essentials course page lists trauma healing as an application, and her Embodywise YouTube channel (206 subscribers) holds almost no teaching videos led by her; only the book 8 Keys to Practicing Mindfulness would pass cleanly.
